items.description: S0-VTOL with autonomous ship launch/landing capability

notes: Early-stage concept for autonomous S0-VTOL launch/recovery from NOAA research vessel Ron Brown with atmospheric sounding mission. ~$18k preliminary funding identified; customer pursuing additional Ron Brown funding. Spring 2028 target mission date. Requirements: ship launch/autonomous landing, 15k ft ceiling, 1+ km vertical sounding, ~45-day cruise duration, ~8-hour data turnaround, publications expected.
